results.cleanName: Dragon Ball Super Battle Premium Set Vol 1 Bundle Japanese

extendedData.name: Description
extendedData.value:
A glorious reprint of the popular Dragon Ball Super Battle is finally here!
Dragon Ball Super Battle Premium set Vol. 1 includes all 188 cards from the past releases from set 1 to set 4!
Contents:
• 190 cards total (160 normal cards, 30 holo cards)
• Binder x1
• Booklet x1
• Binder divider x4
• Refill x16

Disclaimer: all products included in this set were printed in Japanese only
